**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Live entertainment is passive and cloud-dependent. We're making it
collaborative, real-time, and distributed. Creators compose with attention
instead of renting it. You'll be building **Playbox** — the product at the
center of it, the app creators use to author and run living worlds.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds — participatory experiences
an audience helps shape, run live in venues, streams, and homes. Under the
hood: Bevy engine, distributed collaboration, agents as collaborators,
integrations with TouchDesigner / Unreal / Disguise. Self-hostable, no cloud
dependency.

State that changes at frame rate. How you keep dozens of devices, inputs, and outputs synchronized to within milliseconds. When you have 20,000 concurrent actors all reading and writing the same shared world, how do you not drop it. How messages flow between nodes on a mesh and arrive in the right order at the right time.

## What You'll Do

What you'll ship in your first 90 days: The World layer — shared state environment that can hold the engagement loop for a live event at 1,000+ concurrent users and stay under 125ms.

## What We're Looking For

Rust systems engineers (production-level). Distributed systems / CRDT / mesh
networking. Fullstack JS/TS. LLM integration experience. Game dev and/or
Kubernetes background is a bonus.

- Distributed systems — can design event-driven, state-synchronization architectures and reason about their failure modes
- Network protocols — the real-time IP protocols: MoQ / WebRTC; knows when to build custom vs. compose from existing primitives
- Real-time constraint thinking — latency budgets, backpressure, queue depth; not just "fast" but frame-accurate
- Polyglot comfort — Rust and Python; doesn't panic when the language changes
- Kubernetes and control planes — comfort here is highly desired
- Agentic development — can describe a system architecture in plain language precise enough that an AI can scaffold it

Adjacent experience that signals: Game networking, OSC/MIDI/ArtNet protocol experience, live streaming infrastructure, WebSocket at scale, actor model / message-passing architectures

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
